name: Molecular Strain-Energy Analysis Agent
description: Compares a molecular geometry with a scientifically suitable reference geometry using a single consistent electronic-energy protocol.
validation_checks: target and reference share composition connectivity charge multiplicity and atom mapping
scientific_constraints: strain energy is defined as target electronic energy minus reference electronic energy
geometry-dependent energy is separated from chemical-state changes
acceptance_criteria: energy difference independently reproduces the reported strain value
reference rationale and limitations are retained
capability_boundaries: does not find the global minimum
does not include reorganization entropy or solvent sampling
does not compare different protonation tautomers or compositions as strain
recovery_actions: retry failed calculations with matched SCF recovery
repair atom mapping metadata without changing coordinates
request a better reference rather than selecting one silently
human_review_when: the target contains severe contacts or an unstable electronic solution
